blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — At least 159 foreign nationals, including 128 Indonesians, were rounded up at an alleged “parcel scam hub” in Pasay City on Tuesday, Nov. 2, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said. According to the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), the new scheme that has been operating for three months targeted Vietnamese, Chinese, Malaysian, and Indonesian nationals. “As of now we have accounted [for] 159 personalities tagged rescued and persons of interest,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a briefing at a Pasay City office, where the scam hub was located. Other foreign nationals were from […]...
